summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides continuously, re-pricing every ~3s with the touch. The detector read fills on the trader's own SELL quotes as 'opposite-side executions' against cancelled BUY quotes. The tape shows no BUY executions at all, the SELL quotes were genuinely trading (17504 filled), the BUY quote is below depth, and there is no market-moving one-sided display followed by a favourable trade. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 321 each (desk typical 327) and re-priced every 1-10s, cancelling and replacing both sides together. Only fills were on its own BUY quote (136 total); no opposite-side execution, so no benefit. Detector fired on gross quoting volume and cancel ratio, which are normal for a quoting algorithm. Closure standard met: explanation supported, both core features absent.

Agency trader T-X1005-05 had a 21768 BUY ICEBERG (parent C-T-X1005-05-A) at 10002 that was executing: 5835 filled in partial fills from 15:08:57 to 15:09:09, all before the only opposite-side trade, a 544 SELL under a different parent (C-T-X1005-05-B) at 15:09:18. The remainder of 15933 was cancelled 2s later. The order was working (feature a absent). The smaller opposite trade belongs to a different client order, so it is not a round trip and is ordinary order management (feature b absent). No prior alerts, no repetition.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric 391-lot bid/ask pair every 1-13 s, following the touch. Cancel symmetry 0.997, resting size 0.16x depth, 0.29 ticks from touch. The only executions were on its own BUY quotes (449 lots, before any other trade). There was no opposite-side (SELL) execution, so no benefit. The detector's 'BUY execution' is a partial fill (58) on the trader's own resting bid. Feature (a) absent (orders were quotes and were trading). Feature (b) absent. Close as market making.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided BUY limit of 38461 (15.7x avg top-5 depth, 2 ticks from touch) at 12:50:39.339, then sold 1423 at market at 12:50:41.863 while the bid sat at 9996-9997, and cancelled the whole BUY 360 ms later. No fills on the BUY, no supported legitimate explanation. Both core features appear present; one cycle only, so escalate to Level 2 rather than propose a STOR draft.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 366 per order and re-priced every 1-4s. Cancels are symmetric (0.98). The only executions were on its own BUY quotes (441 total, before any sell-side trade). There was no opposite-side execution, so no benefit. The detector's size trigger counted cumulative quote refreshes, not any single large order (max resting size is 0.15x depth). Closure standard is met.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting 391 on both sides in lock-step, re-quoted every few seconds. Detector fired on gross BUY submitted vs depth and two SELL partial fills (126 and 118) on the trader's own resting ask. No single large order (max 0.16x depth), cancels symmetric (0.987), no favourable price move, no reversion, no repetition of a one-sided cycle. Closure standard met via market making.

PROP-EQ trader (not a registered MM) placed one BUY limit of 27326 (11.2x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks off the touch, sold 640 at market 2.2s later, and cancelled the remaining 22619 BUY about 0.7s after the sale. The pattern is one-sided (cancel_symmetry 0.0). The only BUY fill (4707) came after the sale, so the order was not working beforehand. Price moved 1 tick in the trader's favour, reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel, and the round trip was +1.76 ticks. No legitimate explanation is supported. Only one cycle in the session, so I propose escalation, not a STOR draft; Level 2 decides.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoting a bid and an ask of 356 every 1-6 seconds, re-priced between 9998/9999 and 10002/10003. The detector fired on gross BUY size and a SELL fill of 14+342 at 10003 followed by a BUY cancel. The tape shows two-sided symmetric quotes (cancel_symmetry 0.98) at desk-typical size and 0.15x depth. Price did not move in the trader's favour and did not revert, so there is no feature (b). The quotes had a purpose, so feature (a) is absent. Ordinary market making.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size of 2464 (about 1.03x average top-5 depth). Bids and asks are placed and cancelled together and re-priced with the touch. Its own quotes were executing. There was no favourable price move, no reversion and a slightly negative round trip. Both core features are absent and market making is supported. Proposed CLOSE_FP.

Prop trader T-X1009-05 (no registered MM on SYN.A, typical size 500) placed a one-sided BUY of 18930 (7.9x top-5 depth) 1 tick below the best bid and cancelled it after about 0.8s. A 1893 BUY at the same price followed 0.4s later. There was no fill of any kind, so no opposite-side execution and no benefit (feature b) is shown. No legitimate explanation is supported by the tape, so the closure standard is not met and feature (a) cannot be excluded. Evidence is mixed: the profile and the order-size pattern look suspicious, but there is no benefit, no repetition and no history. Escalate to Level 2. This is not a STOR draft candidate on this tape.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 356 each, re-pricing roughly every 1-6s. Cancels are symmetric (0.993), resting size is 0.15x depth, and orders sit within about 0.7 ticks of the touch. The price moved 1 tick against the trader before its opposite-side fill, with no reversion. The detector fired on gross two-sided quote churn, not one-sided displayed size. Both core features are absent, and market making is supported.

ALGO-EXEC trader T-X1012-02 ran two-sided PEGGED child orders (parents P-T-X1012-02-B and P-T-X1012-02-S) of 2424 at the touch on SYN.A. Bid and ask were refreshed together, following the touch. The detector fired on gross size and quick cancels. Cancel symmetry is 0.996, size is about 1.0x depth, distance from touch is 0, and there is no favourable move with reversion. The executions were small. The pattern is algorithmic re-pricing, not spoofing. Close as false positive.

Prop trader placed five BUY limit orders of 4340 each (21700 gross, 8.7x top-5 depth) on five levels 3 ticks from the touch, with no same-side fills. About 2 s later a SELL market order filled 799 at 9995/9993 after the bid had risen 2 ticks. All five buys were cancelled within about 0.3-0.9 s of that sale and the price reverted 2 ticks. One-sided, no event, no risk event, not a market maker. One cycle only in the session, so Level 2 should decide on the STOR; I propose a draft.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided SELL limit of 21443 (8.17x avg top-5 depth) at 10000, 2 ticks from the touch, with no same-side fills. 2.4s later a BUY market order of 1189 executed at 9998-9999, and the SELL was cancelled 363ms after that buy. No legitimate explanation is supported (not a registered MM, no parent/pegged orders, no risk event, no public event, no fills on the resting order). Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is not demonstrated: the price did not move in the trader's favour (price_move 0, reversion 0) and no round trip is computed. The evidence is mixed and the cycle repeated 3 times in the session, so I propose escalation to Level 2 for review of the other repetitions.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoting a bid and an ask of 3302 (its typical size) at the touch, cancelling and re-quoting both sides together every ~2s. Cancels are symmetric (0.97), the touch moved against the trader before its fills (-0.5 ticks) with no reversion, round trip is ~0.2 ticks (spread income), no repetition of a one-sided cycle, no oversized or away-from-touch orders. Detector fired on gross quote churn vs depth. Closure standard met: market making supported, both core features absent.

ALGO-EXEC trader quoted both sides with PEGGED child orders of two parents (P-T-X1015-06-B / -S), each at the typical size of 1984 and at the touch. Cancels are symmetric (0.996) and follow the touch re-pricing. There is no one-sided large resting order, no favourable move with reversion, and no repetition cycle. Detector fired on gross size vs depth and on fills that are naturally 'opposite' to the other side's cancels. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent.

PROP trader (no MM registration) rested two BUY limits of 7215 each at 9996 (about 5.5x average top-5 depth, 1.5 ticks from the touch), one-sided, with zero fills. About 2.6s before cancelling, the trader sold 515 at 10001 after the bid had risen from 9997 to 10000 (+1.5 ticks favourable). Both bids were cancelled together at 15:13:23.140, 142 ms after an unscheduled issuer news item, and the price then reverted 2 ticks. The news came after the sale, so it cannot explain the resting orders or the sale. Core features (a) and (b) are plausibly present, and the news-reaction explanation covers only the cancel timing. The evidence is mixed, so this goes to Level 2. It is a single cycle, so I do not propose a STOR draft.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric 395-lot bid/ask pair every 1-6s. Orders are about 15% of top-5 depth, not large. The only executions were on its own BUY quotes (422 lots) and there was no opposite-side (SELL) execution. So there is no one-sided resting order and no opposite-side benefit. The detector's 'gross SELL 8690 vs depth' trigger counts the cumulative refresh of small quotes, not a large resting order.

A 11,565 BUY limit at 10003 (4.6x depth) was working: it filled 1,387 at 11:40:13 and 1,387 at 11:40:17, 2,774 in total, before the trader's only opposite-side trade (SELL 346 at 11:40:25). That is 24% of the quantity submitted and eight times the opposite quantity. The later 7,866 reduction was a MODIFY on the remainder, and the order kept filling afterwards (12 at 11:40:29). This is genuine execution of the resting order with ordinary order management, so feature (a) is absent. The small sell is not feature (b) under section 6.2. There is no event, no repetition and no prior alert. The order was one-sided, not market making.

Single BUY LIMIT of 23620 (9.5x top-5 depth) at 9996, 1 tick behind the bid of 9997, cancelled after ~966 ms. 400 ms later the trader re-entered a BUY of 2362 at the same price, exactly one tenth of the size, which looks like a corrected fat-finger entry (extra digit). No fills on either side, so there is no opposite-side execution and no benefit; no repetition, no prior alerts. Size alone is not a feature. Closed as a fat-finger entry error.

PROP trader placed five one-sided SELL limit orders (4,734 each, 23,670 gross, 4 price levels 10006-10009) within about 60 ms, up to 9.4x average top-5 depth, then bought 624 at the ask by market order at 12:38:36.111 and cancelled all five sells 215-951 ms later. No same-side fills, cancel_symmetry 0, cancel ratio 1.0. Price moved 1 tick in the trader's favour before the buy and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. No registered MM, no risk event, no public event, no parent/pegged orders. Both core features appear present and no accepted explanation is supported. Single cycle in the session, and the favourable move is modest, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 rather than DRAFT_STOR.

Prop trader's single BUY 19570 at 9996 (7.96x depth) was executing: 3568 filled (18% of submitted) before the only opposite-side trade, a SELL of 587 (smaller than the prior fills). The remaining 14437 was reduced by MODIFY, leaving 1565. Under section 6.2 an order working before a smaller opposite trade is ordinary order management: feature (a) absent, feature (b) not established. Caveats: the order was large, one-sided, and the touch moved +2 ticks with a 3-tick round trip. No reversion could be measured, there are no repetitions, no prior alerts, and no market event.

T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quoted BUY and SELL 335 together and re-priced them every 1-6s. Orders were at or inside the touch and about 13% of average depth. There was no favourable price move and no reversion, so neither core feature is present. The detector's 'gross BUY 8375 >= 3.25x depth' trigger counts repeated 335 refreshes, not a large resting order.

PROP-EQ trader (no MM registration) rested three one-sided BUY limits of 4514 each (13542 total, max 5.4x top-5 depth, 6 ticks from touch) for ~14-16s with zero fills, sold 700 at market (13:51:04.003) and cancelled all three bids 600 ms later. Feature (a) is present: large, away from touch, never executed, no supported explanation. Feature (b) looks absent: price fell 1.5 ticks against the trader, no reversion, round trip -4.77 ticks. Mixed evidence with no accepted explanation, so Level 2 should review; not enough for a STOR draft (no repetition, no benefit).

Algo trader placed a single one-sided SELL LIMIT of 20314 (8.3x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, then 1.8s later sent a BUY MARKET of 1130 that filled across 9999-10002, and cancelled the whole SELL 127 ms after the buy. No same-side fills, no parent order, not pegged, not a registered MM, no risk event, no public event. Prior closures relied on a pegged algo with symmetric cancels and parent orders; none of that holds today. Price benefit is weak (+0.5 tick move, 1.5 tick reversion after cancel; the buy walked up the book and no round trip is computed), and it is a single cycle, so evidence is mixed. Not enough for a STOR draft, but no accepted explanation is supported, so Level 2 should review.

AGENCY trader worked a 17528 BUY ICEBERG at the touch (parent C-A). It executed 2990 (17% of qty) before a separate 438 SELL under a different parent (C-B) filled; the remainder was cancelled 2s later. The resting order was working (feature a absent). The SELL was a different client's order, with no favourable price move and no reversion (feature b absent). Iceberg/genuine execution is supported.

Trader T-X1028-09 placed one SELL LIMIT of 31395 at 10006 (12.9x avg top-5 depth, 3 ticks from touch) at 16:05:17.526. Three seconds later they sent a BUY MARKET order that filled 1053 on the opposite side at 10002-10003. The SELL was cancelled 158 ms after that, unfilled. The order was one-sided, never executed, and was removed right after the opposite-side trade; after the cancel the price fell 2.5 ticks. Trader is a registered MM only on SYN.B, there is no public event and no risk event. No legitimate explanation is supported. It is a single cycle, so I propose escalation rather than a STOR draft. Level 2 decides.

Pegged execution algo quoting both sides at the touch under two parents. Orders are about one times depth, cancels are symmetric, and 6657 executed on its own BUY orders before the only opposite-side fill of 1118. The price moved against the trader with no reversion. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported; neither core feature is present. Proposed close as false positive.

Three BUY limit orders of 5152 (15456 total, 6.1x top-5 depth, 2 ticks from touch) were placed over 10s. A 772 SELL filled at 10006 with no favourable price move (price_move_ticks 0.0) and no reversion after the cancel. All three BUYs were cancelled at 13:35:37.550, the same instant as a recorded automated kill switch (intraday loss limit breach) that cancelled all resting orders. Feature (b), a benefit, is absent. The cancel is explained by the risk event, so the resting orders were interrupted rather than removed after a gain. Size and one-sidedness were noted, but size alone is not a feature. Closing as a risk-system cancellation.
